subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new Gateway-backed batch dictation workflow in Control UI, separate from current Talk transcription-only and audio attachment paths?
rationale: The implementation adds user-facing voice UX plus a new authenticated audio RPC that can invoke configured providers/local CLIs, so the permanent product and security boundary needs maintainer intent beyond a mechanical rebase.

options.title: Sponsor after rebase and proof
options.body: Keep this PR direction alive, require the current-main UI port, accessibility fix, passing docs/checks, and redacted real browser proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader voice direction
options.body: Pause this PR and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 the place to decide batch dictation versus Talk transcription UX.

options.title: Decline separate dictation RPC
options.body: Close this PR direction and steer users to Talk transcription-only or audio attachment workflows until maintainers request a dedicated composer path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR direction alive, require the current-main UI port, accessibility fix, passing docs/checks, and redacted real browser proof before merge.
